title: My Dream World-can anyone relate?
content: Hi everyone, I’ve been having the same recurring dreams for decades now, taking place in the same dream world. The dream world appears to be a combination of real and “dream” places. It’s like a mix of my hometown, college town, and other familiar places mixed together but the familiarity of it is really due to me visiting the same spots over and over again in my dreams over the years. I also have characters that appear over and over, sometimes it is family or friends but they are slightly different in my dream world. Just last night I had a dream that I was living in a large mansion with all of my friends. Often times the houses will have things the previous owners left, and there will be a lot of objects and clutter around. In my dream a friend of my had a kid (he doesn’t have kids irl) and had to leave because the kid was being fussy. It all sounds pretty normal/tame just how real life can be boring and normal. The only disturbing part is how REAL this world feels to me. I feel like I live in another reality that I only visit at night. It’s hard for me to wake up from these dreams sometimes because I don’t want to leave that world. Can anyone else relate?
